author: NorthEast News Desk
body: Seven people, including a Providence police officer, were taken to hospitals after a four-vehicle crash late Friday at Thurbers and Prairie avenues, police said. The collision began while the officer was responding to a service call.

According to Providence police, another car struck the cruiser and triggered a chain reaction that pulled two additional vehicles into the crash. The officer was treated and later released from the hospital. Six other occupants were hospitalized with complaints of pain; authorities did not report more detailed information about their conditions.

The intersection is near major routes through the southern part of the city, and the late-night response brought police and medical crews to the area. Investigators have not announced whether citations or charges are expected, and no cause beyond the initial sequence of impacts has been released. Police said the investigation remains ongoing. The number of vehicles and patients makes the incident one of the larger traffic responses reported in Providence overnight.
dek: A cruiser responding to a service call was struck at Thurbers and Prairie avenues, setting off a crash involving four vehicles.
headline: Seven hospitalized after Providence police-cruiser chain crash
